title: 第23章 异变突生第24章 喜提混沌魔女称号
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
最终决战的擂台早已准备就绪，光华流转，符文密布，远比之前的擂台坚固。
台下人山人海，所有目光都聚焦在即将登台的两人身上——忘忧峰云杳杳与碧波峰柳依依。
柳依依神色凝重，调息凝神，准备全力以赴。
虽自知胜算渺茫，但能走到这一步已是意外之喜，她只想尽力一战，不负碧波峰之名。
而云杳杳却显得有些心不在焉，目光不时扫过人群，似乎在寻找着什么。
方才那符峰弟子捏碎传讯物的举动，以及那一闪而逝的隐晦黑气，让她心中警铃大作。
她感觉，这决赛恐怕只是个幌子，真正的危机或许正在酝酿。
“最终决战，开始！”
执事长老高声宣布。
柳依依深吸一口气，周身水波荡漾，一柄如秋水般的长剑出现在手中，剑尖遥指：“云师妹，请！”
云杳杳收回目光，看向柳依依，点了点头：“柳师姐，请。”
两人身形同时而动！
柳依依剑势展开，如同碧波万顷，绵密不绝，又暗藏汹涌暗流，将碧波峰水系剑法的精妙展现得淋漓尽致。
云杳杳则依旧以那神乎其神的身法和精准的点穴手法应对，并未主动强攻，似乎意在切磋，而非争胜。
两人剑来指往，身影交错，灵力碰撞间激起道道涟漪，场面看似激烈，实则节奏控制在云杳杳手中，如同演练。
台下观众看得如痴如醉，为柳依依的精妙剑法喝彩，也为云杳杳那不可思议的闪避与化解技巧惊叹。
高台上，长老们纷纷颔首，对两人的表现表示赞赏。
然而，就在比赛进行到一刻钟，柳依依一剑刺出，云杳杳正欲侧身避让的瞬间——
异变陡生！
“嗡——！

！”
一声沉闷却响彻天地的嗡鸣突然从地底深处传来！
整个青云宗主峰剧烈地震动起来！
仿佛有一头沉睡的太古巨兽正在地底翻身！
紧接着，笼罩整个宗门的巨大护山光幕发出一阵令人牙酸的扭曲声，表面光华疯狂闪烁明灭，仿佛承受着难以想象的压力！
“怎么回事？！”
“地龙翻身了？！”
“快看护山大阵！”
台下瞬间大乱！
弟子们惊慌失措，站立不稳！
高台上，所有长老瞬间色变，猛地站起身！
“不好！
护山大阵遭到猛烈攻击！”
阵峰长老失声惊呼！
“敌袭！
是敌袭！”
执法长老严正怒吼，“所有弟子听令！
结阵防御！
content_en:
The arena for the final decisive battle has been prepared for a long time, with brilliance flowing, densely covered with runes, and far stronger than the previous arena.
The audience was packed with people, and all eyes were focused on the two people who were about to take the stage - Wangyou Peak Yun Yaoyao and Bibo Peak Liu Yiyi.
Liu Yiyi looked solemn, adjusted her breath and concentration, and was ready to go all out.
Although she knew that her chances of winning were slim, it was an unexpected surprise that she could reach this point. She just wanted to fight with her best and live up to the name of Bibo Peak.
But Yun Yaoyao seemed a little absent-minded, his eyes scanning the crowd from time to time, as if he was looking for something.
The action of the Fu Feng disciple crushing the communication object just now, as well as the flash of vague black energy, set off alarm bells in her heart.
She felt that this final was probably just a cover, and a real crisis might be brewing.
"The final battle begins!"
The elder deacon announced loudly.
Liu Yiyi took a deep breath, water rippled around her body, and a long sword like autumn water appeared in her hand. The tip of the sword pointed far away: "Junior sister Yun, please!"
Yun Yaoyao withdrew her gaze, looked at Liu Yiyi, and nodded: "Senior Sister Liu, please."
The two figures moved at the same time!
Liu Yiyi's sword spread out like a vast expanse of blue waves, endless and dense, with hidden turbulent undercurrents, vividly displaying the exquisiteness of Bibo Peak's water-based swordsmanship.
Yun Yaoyao still responded with his miraculous body skills and precise acupuncture techniques, and did not take the initiative to attack. He seemed to be aiming for a discussion rather than a fight for victory.
The two men were pointing their swords back and forth, their figures intertwined, and the collision of spiritual powers caused ripples. The scene seemed intense, but in fact the rhythm was controlled by Yun Yaoyao's hands, just like a drill.
The audience watched in ecstasy, applauding Liu Yiyi's exquisite swordsmanship, and marveling at Yun Yaoyao's incredible dodge and resolution skills.
On the high platform, the elders nodded one after another and expressed their appreciation for the performance of the two people.
However, just a quarter of an hour into the game, Liu Yiyi thrust out his sword, and Yun Yaoyao was about to step aside to avoid it——
A sudden change occurred!
“Buzz—!
! "
A dull but resounding buzz suddenly came from deep underground!
The entire main peak of the Qingyun Sect shook violently!
It seems as if there is a sleeping ancient beast turning over underground!
Immediately afterwards, the huge mountain-protecting light curtain that enveloped the entire sect made a heart-wrenching twisting sound, and the brilliance on its surface flickered wildly, as if it was under unimaginable pressure!
"What's going on?!"
"The earth dragon turned over?!"
"Hurry and guard the mountain formation!"
The audience was instantly in chaos!
The disciples were panicked and unsteady on their feet!
On the high platform, all the elders suddenly changed their expressions and stood up suddenly!
"Not good!
The mountain guard formation was violently attacked! "
The elder of the array peak exclaimed!
"Enemy attack!
It's an enemy attack! "
The law enforcement elder shouted solemnly, "All disciples, obey the order!
Form a defense!
